description: MCP server for the Mamba Labs LinkedIn Post Tracker and Comment Capture actor on Apify. Profiles and company pages in, their recent posts with real engagement counts out, plus the commenters LinkedIn shows publicly. No cookies, no account.

tool_signatures.name: capture_linkedin_posts_and_commenters
tool_signatures.description: Point it at LinkedIn person profiles or company pages and it returns the posts a search engine has indexed for each one, as flat rows: permalink, author, a text excerpt, and the publish date decoded from the post id. No request is sent to LinkedIn and no cookie or account is used. A result counts only when its permalink names the source, so posts are never attributed to the wrong author. Coverage is what the search index holds: posts appear days or weeks after publishing and many never appear. Commenters, reaction counts, comment counts and media are no longer returned (removed 2026-10-12, they came only from LinkedIn pages). Rows carry row_type post or notice; filter on row_type before loading a table. post_id is the activity URN and is stable across runs. Every row carries degraded and degradation_reason. Requires an APIFY_TOKEN and consumes Apify credits. Read only.

profile_urls.description: LinkedIn person profile URLs, for example https://www.linkedin.com/in/williamhgates. Country subdomains such as uk.linkedin.com are fine. Supply this, company_urls, or both.

company_urls.description: LinkedIn company page URLs, for example https://www.linkedin.com/company/microsoft. Supply this, profile_urls, or both.

posted_since.description: ISO date or timestamp, for example 2026-08-01. Posts published before this are skipped BEFORE anything is charged. Leave empty to take everything the index holds.
